mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the discount rate for equity valuation models, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it indicates a severe labor market contraction that depresses consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 515 thousand units and retail sales below 335,000 million dollars indicates a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers negative earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a reading of industrial production above 95 (index 2017=100) indicates a strengthening manufacturing sector that boosts corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 95 during the post-recession recovery regime, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 500 thousand units indicates a resilient residential construction sector that supports household wealth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 500, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level below 330,000 million dollars indicates a contraction in consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS < 330000, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a federal funds rate at or below 0.2% and a consumer price index below 210 (index 1982-1984=100) indicates a deflationary monetary policy stance that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the recessionary labor market regime, a payroll level below 132,000 thousand indicates a severe employment contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS < 132000 during the recessionary labor market regime, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
